Hi Liam / Novus marketing team,

Thanks for the earlier intro — excited about the idea of running a short Co-Clinic series (3 x half-day, hands-on workshops) co-branded between Novus and Redwood. The basic concept we discussed:

- Audience: Practitioners (platform engineers + ML infra) at target accounts; ~60–80 attendees per session.
- Format: 3 regional half-day clinics (west / central / east) with live instructor-led labs and a short product deep dive.
- Redwood contribution: instructors (2 per clinic), demo kit (GPU laptop + 1 device), collateral templates, and registration page.
- Novus contribution: co-branded landing page, speaker slot, and local venue/food coordination where you lead ops on your side.

Open questions we need to nail down: MDF amount and split, target dates (we're thinking late Jan–Feb), attendee targets per region, and who owns lead follow-up. From Redwood's side we typically ask for MDF to cover venue + catering + local promotion; for a 3-city run we'd estimate $18k–24k total.

Can you share (a) whether Novus would be open to a 60/40 MDF split (Novus 60% / Redwood 40%) or suggest an alternative, (b) any blackout dates in Jan–Feb, and (c) rough attendee goals per city? Once we align we can spin up a short MOU and a schedule draft.

I'll loop in Grace and Kimberly for logistics and booth/tech planning.

Cheers,
Sean Gallagher
Head of Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
